translator.evidence: A complete Gujarati catalog was supplied across all 1,315 source keys, preserving placeholders, plural forms and standard technical notation; no individual translator identity is asserted. Updated 2026-09-28 with 69 original messages for change review, agent questions, permission rules, connectors, background runs, research progress and budgets. Placeholders and locale-specific plural forms are preserved; no upstream translated text was copied.

reviewer.evidence: Independently read every message in all 12 slices against the English defaults for Gujarati meaning, neutral UI register, Gujarati script and context; reviewed each English-identical value. Corrected plural forms for messages, threads, tools, highlighted passages and child nodes, plus an untranslated “of” in a flow announcement. Parsing confirms all ordered keys/placeholders and CLDR one/other forms. AI-assisted; no native-speaker certification is claimed. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.
